summary: The pixel-art visual style is consistently rendered with clean character sprites and hero objects. Some late shots suffer from visual repetition and incomplete action matching.

clean: Character proportions and floating hands remain consistent across beach scenes.
Mate and thermos objects scale appropriately relative to character bodies.
unclean: Shot 3: Background umbrella graphic gets clipped abruptly at the left frame edge.
Shot 12: Visual continues showing wind/yerba effect instead of transitioning to the vacation start scene.

clean: Pixel art aesthetic, outline strokes, and color palette strictly follow the template.
Typography remains legible with clear yellow highlights.
unclean: Shot 3: Edge cropping on background props breaks scene composition.
Shots 11-13: Repetitive character animation frames across different script lines.

issues.problem: Background props clipped at frame border
issues.fix: Adjust camera bounds or prop position to avoid visual hard cuts.

issues.problem: Visual repeat of yerba blowing instead of showing new scene
issues.fix: Add distinct visual asset representing the spoken line.

issues.problem: "heladerita" is named but pixel8 has no drawing for it
issues.fix: add a heladerita drawing to pixel8 and its column in styles/lexicon.js

learnings.rule: Avoid reusing particle animation loops across distinct spoken context changes.
Ensure background elements remain entirely inside camera viewport bounds.
